title: Definitive Vanilla
description: Vanilla+ modpack that improves performance, graphics, and mob animations without changing core gameplay.
body:
![Definitive Vanilla Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1d4c6ef5614eed91c018aa360a65ce4ea027118_0.webp)

A performance-focused Vanilla+ modpack that enhances optimization, visuals, and multiplayer without changing core gameplay.

### 🚀 Performance
* **Frame Rate Boosts:** Built on a lighter framework that maximizes FPS while reducing memory usage and chunk lag.

### 🎨 Visuals
* **Fresh Animations:** Gives mobs more realistic movements and expressions.
* **3D & Glowing Details:** Adds 3D item models and glowing ores for a more immersive environment.
* **Pre-Configured Shaders:** Includes a built-in shader pack for enhanced lighting and vibrant shadows right out of the box.

### 🛠️ Quality of Life & Multiplayer
* **Built-in Multiplayer:** Host your world and invite friends directly via a peer-to-peer connection without needing a separate server.
* **UI Tweaks:** Includes quick inventory navigation, zoom functionality, and detailed item tooltips.
